What complex number is represented in the Argand diagram above?
worked_solution:
The coordinates of the point are $(0,4).$

- The real part of this complex number is $x=0,$ and

- the imaginary part is $y=4.$

Therefore, the number depicted is $z=0+4\text{i},$ which can be simplified to $z=4\text{i}.$
